name: Mithralda — FOUNTAINS dark-fantasy palette
supersedes: palette.json (warm earthy medieval) — ADOPTED, board-approved 2026-06-29 (approval c360188d, CAS-200); integration CAS-201
note: Palette-by-role for the FOUNTAINS dark-fantasy re-style. Same readability discipline as the warm palette but ~40-55% less saturated, darker ambient, cold-shifted shadows. Environment sinks into gloom; actors are pale steel/leather silhouettes that pop ONLY by cold contrast; signal hues are the only saturated glow and appear ONLY on hazards/FX/pickups. Single source of truth for both the runtime renderer COL{} and the asset pipeline once adopted.

environment._desc: Ground/terrain. Cold, desaturated, dim so it recedes into shadow. base/light/dark = flat/highlight/shadow per tile.

actors._desc: Player classes + NPCs/enemies. Pale, cold, never bright — read by contrast against the dark, with a cold rim light. Shared parts keep the cast coherent; per-class accent gives identity within the family.

signal._desc: Reserved hues for combat/hazards/pickups — the ONLY saturated/glowing colors. Must NOT appear on terrain or actors so the eye reads them instantly against the gloom.

ui._desc: Frames, panels, text. Cold iron-and-stone framing over a near-black field — grimmer than the warm wood UI.
